name: Engine round contract
userOutcome: Counting behavior is deterministic: advance increments until target, completion fires once at N, undo never goes below 0, invalid targets are clamped.
productionDataSource: Pure in-memory JapaEngine value type; no I/O.
errorBehavior: Out-of-range targets clamp to 1...1080. Advances after completion return alreadyComplete without mutating count. Undo at 0 is a no-op floor.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not couple mantra text into count logic
Do not add streak/chain fields to engine state
Do not change completion-once semantics without a decision + contract update
acceptanceTests: JapaEngineTests — full suite (defaults, boundaries, undo, completion-once, reconstruct)
